text: Praise the Lord. Praise the Lord, O my soul.
I will sing praise to my God as long as I live.
in mortal men, who cannot save.
on that very day their plans come to nothing.
whose hope is in the Lord his God,
the sea, and everything in them— the Lord, who remains faithful forever.
and gives food to the hungry. The Lord sets prisoners free,
the Lord lifts up those who are bowed down, the Lord loves the righteous.
and sustains the fatherless and the widow, but he frustrates the ways of the wicked.
your God, O Zion, for all generations. Praise the Lord.
